summary: In the dojo, Morpheus presses the sparring attack, countering Neo's blows while slipping in several stinging slaps and goading him: "You're faster than this. Don't think you are. Know you are." He cracks Neo again, and Neo's face twists with rage as the speed of the blows rises like a drum solo. Morpheus taunts, "Come on! Stop trying to hit me and just hit me." Then a single blow catches Morpheus on the side of the head, knocking off his glasses.

what_changes.before: Being countered and slapped by Morpheus, unable to land a clean hit
what_changes.after: Roused to rage, his speed rising, and finally landing a blow
what_changes.evidence: Neo's face twists with rage as the speed of the blows rises like a drum solo.

what_changes.before: Trying to hit Morpheus but failing to connect
what_changes.after: Actually hitting Morpheus, knocking off his glasses
what_changes.evidence: Wham. A single blow catches Morpheus on the side of the head, knocking off his glasses.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus goads Neo into finally landing a real blow during their dojo fight.

uncertain: Whether this single connected blow marks a lasting turning point or is only a momentary success in the ongoing fight.
